export type Shape = { kind: "circle" } | { kind: "square" } | { kind: "triangle" };
function consume(value: string): void {}
export function inspect(value: any, flag: string, shape: Shape): string {
  if (flag) {}
  const propagated: string = value;
  consume(value);
  value.missing();
  const asserted = value as string;
  switch (shape.kind) {
    case "circle": return value;
    case "square": return asserted;
  }
  return propagated;
}
